context: A dad teases his teen daughter about her online habits
purpose: Teach: イイ/雑記/ブログランキング/オヤジ/幾ら/つづけ/有無/不快

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: おい桜、また寝ないでスマホ見てんのか？イイ加減にしろよ。
lines.en: Hey Sakura, you're on your phone again instead of sleeping? Give it a rest.
lines.style: Teasing dad tone, slightly exasperated but warm and familiar.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今ね、友達の雑記ブログ読んでたの。けっこう面白いんだから。
lines.en: I was reading my friend's diary-style blog. It's actually pretty interesting.
lines.style: Defensive teen voice, mildly annoyed but not hostile yet.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 雑記ブログ？それってブログランキングとかに載ってんの？
lines.en: A diary blog? Is it on one of those blog rankings or whatever?
lines.style: Curious dad trying to sound hip but failing endearingly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: オヤジがそんな言葉知ってんの、ちょっとキモい。幾ら検索しても出てこない隠れた名作なの。
lines.en: Gross that you even know that word, dad. It's a hidden gem you won't find no matter how much you search.
lines.style: Snarky teenage daughter, mock-disgusted but secretly amused tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 失礼な。父さんだって流行に詳しいんだぞ。で、何時間読みつづけてんだよ。
lines.en: How rude. Dad knows trends too, you know. So how many hours have you been reading?
lines.style: Playfully offended father, puffing up his chest comically.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 三時間くらい？でも有無を言わさず取り上げるのはやめてよね。
lines.en: Like three hours? But don't just snatch it away without asking, okay?
lines.style: Sheepish admission followed by a sharp warning to her dad.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 取らないって。ただな、寝不足だと朝から不快な気分になるぞ。父さんの経験談だ。
lines.en: I won't take it. But lack of sleep makes mornings miserable. Dad's been there.
lines.style: Softer, genuinely caring dad advice with self-deprecating humor.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はいはい、あと一記事だけ読んだら寝る。約束ね、オヤジ。
lines.en: Yeah yeah, just one more post and I'll sleep. Promise, old man.
lines.style: Affectionate teasing back, conceding the argument with warmth.
